decision: Each landing zone must have its own parameter file and its own trigger workflow.
why: A shared trigger means acting on one landing zone risks redeploying another team.

links.note: Per landing zone triggers share centralized deployment logic through the reusable workflow.
The app registration's credentials are what let the template deploy landing zone resources.

violations: Generated workflow name not matching the lz-* prefix, which breaks fan-out discovery.
One parameter file covering more than one landing zone.
